required_outcomes: Records the landlord's decision of 24 December: the tenant's machine may stay for the rest of the tenancy as the tenant's own responsibility, his machine is not to be repaired, and he will collect it from the garage himself.
Closes the request without payment, with the landlord's informed agreement taken from his own email and the tenant's report as the resolution evidence.

Gives the tenant a short update that the landlord is happy for their machine to stay, that it is theirs to maintain, and that he will arrange a time with them to collect his old machine in the new year.
acceptable_alternatives: Closing without a further tenant message, provided the record shows the agency's email of 24 December (event 011) already told the tenant and the landlord's decision is noted on the file.
Setting a light follow-up for after the tenants return to confirm the landlord's machine has been collected.
positive_behaviours: Notes on the property record that the washing machine is now tenant-owned and the landlord's is to be removed, so the inventory and check-out are right.
Mentions that the landlord's collection from the garage needs the tenant's agreement or 24 hours' notice.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or holding the request open when every party has confirmed the outcome.
Asking the landlord again for a decision he has already given.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a maintenance provider or booking a visit.
Recording any payment on this request.
critical_failures: Sending a contractor to inspect, repair or remove the machine against the landlord's written instruction that nothing further is needed.
